parole.significato: (Originally a title of honour of the Pope, later used for all priests and later for aristocrats)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Spanish don, which is from Latin dominus (“lord”).

parole.significato: infante (son of the king of Spain or Portugal)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Spanish infante, from Latin īnfāns.

parole.significato: real (former unit of currency of Spain and Spain's colonies)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Spanish real, from Latin rēgālis (“regal, royal”).
